spans.s: 1 रसन n. roaring, screaming, sounding i.g.

रशनाकलाप m. a woman's girdle twisted of several
strings.
रश्म॑न् m. rein (only instr. रश्मा & —˚).
रश्मिजाल n. a net or garland of rays.
रश्मिपुञ्ज m. heap or multitude of rays.

रश्मिमन्त् a. having rays, radiant;
 m. the sun.
रश्मिमय a. consisting of rays.
रश्मिमालिन् a. garlanded with rays.
रश्मिव॑न्त् a. & m. = रश्मिमन्त्.

1 रस् रसति रस˚ते pp. रसित (q.v.) roar, howl, cry,
sound. —अभि neigh to (acc.). आ & वि roar, scream. — Cf.
अनुरसित, आरसित.

2 रस् रसति रस्यति रस॑यति ते taste, relish,
feel, perceive.

रास् रासति रास˚ते roar, howl. I. रारास्यते cry aloud,
lament.
रसगुण a. possessing the quality of taste.
रसज a. produced from liquids.

रसज्ञ a. knowing tastes (lit. & fig.), i.g. judicious,
wise, familiar with (loc. or —˚), abstr. ˚ता f. —n. & f. आ tongue.
रसनीय a. what is tasted.
रसप्रबन्ध m. poetical composition, esp. a drama.

रसमय^1 f. ई consisting of juice or fluids.
[1] Correction submitted by Jim Funderburk on 20160412. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/CORRECTIONS/issues/275. note: alphabetical order, cf. MW, etc.
रसयति s. tasting.
रसयितव्य a. to be tasted, tasty.
रसयितृ॑ m. taster.
रसवत्ता f. abstr. to seq.
रसवर्जम् adv. except taste.
रसविक्रयिन् m. liquor-seller.

रसविद् a. knowing tastes or having good taste (lit. &
fig.).
रसातल n. the lower world, hell.
रसाधिक a. full of taste or enjoyments.

रसान्तर n. another taste, sentiment or character;
difference of tastes.
रसान्तरविद् a. knowing the different tastes.
रसायन n. medicine for prolonging life, an elixir.
रसा॑य्य a. juicy, tasty.
रसाल m. the mango tree.
र॑साशिर् a. mixed with juice (milk).
रसास्वाद m. the perception of enjoyment.
रसिकजन m. elegant people.
रसित a. & n. roaring, crying, tinkling, sounding i.g.
1 रसितृ m. roarer.
2 रसितृ m. taster.
रसि॑न् a. juicy, pithy, strong, tasteful, elegant.
रसोन m. a kind of garlic.
रस्य a. palatable, tasty, savoury.
राशि॑ m. heap, mass, multitude.
राशिशस् adv. by heaps.
राशिस्थ a. standing in a heap, heaped up.
राशीकृ A., ˚भू P. heap or pile up.

राष्ट्र॑ n. kingdom, sovereignty, country, region, people,
subjects.
राष्ट्रक (adj. —˚) = prec.
राष्ट्रकर्षण n. harassing of a country.
राष्ट्रगोप m. king (lit. protector of a kingdom).
राष्ट्र॑पति m. king (lit. protector of a kingdom).
राष्ट्रपाल m. king (lit. protector of a kingdom).
राष्ट्रभङ्ग m. decay of a kingdom.
राष्ट्रभृ॑ति f. ˚भृ॑त्य n. maintenance of dominion.
राष्ट्रभेदिन् m. rebel (divider of a country).
राष्ट्रवर्धन a. increasing dominion.
राष्ट्रि f. female ruler.
रा॑ष्ट्री f. female ruler or manager.
राष्ट्रिक m. inhabitant (subject or ruler).
राष्ट्रि॑न् a. holding a kingdom.

राष्ट्रि॑य m. successor of a king, pretender;
 also = seq.
राष्ट्री॑य m. = राष्ट्रि॑य.
राष्ट्रियस्याल m. a king's brother-in-law (d.).
रा॑सभ m. ˚भी f. ass.

रा॑स्ना f. girdle;
 poss. रास्नाव॑.
रास्पिन॑ a. noisy.
रास्पिर॑ a. noisy.
